shipped.title: HurleyUS/omadesign · pull request 491 opened
shipped.summary: Opened a pull request so Omadesign 0.6.9 can export documents that hold ICC-tagged placed photos together with layer effects. Version 0.6.8 blocked every export of those files. Placed artwork is converted to the document color profile on import, and export renders a temporary copy so the original document stays unchanged. The pull request is open for review and has not merged.
bullets: Place and import convert pixels to the destination document color model and profile
Export of an 8-bit document with tagged photos and effects uses a temporary copy
Layer effects render through that copy instead of blocking the export
The 0.6.8 site update post is included so the latest-update check passes
